input.summary: Insert performance and conformance warranty with a remedy
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 contains only corporate authority representations and no performance warranty. We have added a workmanlike-performance and conformance warranty with a re-performance, repair or refund remedy, plus compliance with law and no malicious code.

ops.text: HDI warrants that (1) the design, development, hosting, operation, maintenance and management of the Site will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards and in compliance with applicable law; (2) for a period of ninety (90) days following the Effective Date, the Site will conform in all material respects to the specifications approved by the Company under Section 5.2; and (3) the Site will not contain any virus or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at HDI's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the amounts paid by the Company in respect of the non-conforming services.

input.comment: [Playbook] HDI hosts the Site and processes customer order data, so standard insurance is expected. We have added our usual general liability, E&O and cyber limits with certificates on request.

ops.text: Insurance. HDI shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, where HDI processes Content, user information or customer data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. HDI shall provide certificates of insurance on request.

input.summary: Insert transition assistance, data return and deletion obligations
input.comment: [Playbook] The termination article says nothing about getting our Content and customer data back or migrating the Site. We have added six months of transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of data in machine-readable form within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter.

ops.text: Transition Assistance; Return of Data. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, HDI shall (a) at the Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at HDI's then-current rates, including cooperation in migrating the Site to the Company or its designee; (b) within thirty (30) days, return to the Company all Content, user information and customer and order data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.
